profile_text: With a focus on artistic and decorative metal castings, this specialized foundry has experienced a 27.3% growth since its baseline, driven by increasing demand for unique and intricate metalwork pieces. As a leading manufacturer in its sector, the company's expertise in crafting custom metal castings has enabled it to expand its operations and workforce, now employing 28 people. This growth trajectory has earned the company a "Scaler" category designation, reflecting its notable expansion and success in the manufacturing industry.
